rosewood.persona: Size 6, wide feet and calves, weekend errands
rosewood.text: The pink suede is exactly what caught my eye in the ad, so I added my usual size 6. The page says the width is "Regular" and gives nothing on calf room or heel grip, so I'm unsure how they'll fit my wide feet and calves.

rosewood.persona: Size 9.5, narrow feet, wide calves, everyday
rosewood.text: Loved the rosy pink suede from the ad, so I got it in my usual 9.5. The page doesn't say anything about sizing, calf fit or heel grip, so it's a bit of a gamble.

elliette.text: Love the look, but nothing tells me it runs small. I'd order my usual 7.
Heel looks walkable. I'd keep it if the fit is true to size.

ebariel.persona: Size 6, wide feet and calves, errands
ebariel.text: The mushroom suede looks just like the ad and I love the block heel, so I ordered my usual 6. I'm a bit nervous about the slim shaft for my wide calves, and the page doesn't say how wide the shaft is.
The mushroom suede knee-high looks right for a wedding, so I got my usual 7.5. The page doesn't say much about comfort, calf fit or whether it's real leather, so I'm guessing on those.

oneameth.persona: Mock customer · US 8, wide feet, 10-hour days
oneameth.text: The nude pump looks great and is the one from the ad, so I ordered my usual 8. The page says the width is "Regular" and the toe is pointed with an 8 cm heel, so I'm unsure it will be comfortable for ten hours on my wide feet.

marigold.text: The gold Marigold is the champagne-gold loafer from the ad, so I got it in my usual 7. I wish the page said more about fit, since the width is listed as Regular and my feet are wide.

marigold.persona: Size 10, wide feet and calves, wedding guest, wants leather · bought Clementinne instead
marigold.text: I loved the champagne gold Marigold in the ad, but the page says metallic faux leather, and I wanted real leather for the wedding. I went with the Clementinne leather loafer instead. It's not as glam, and I'm a bit unsure about the pointed toe with my wide feet.

marigold.persona: Size 6.5, wide feet, wedding guest, suede, cream/taupe · bought Oneameth instead
marigold.text: Real suede in a pale cream nude is exactly what I wanted for the wedding. I'm nervous about an 8 cm stiletto with a narrow pointed toe on wide feet for six hours, though, and the page never says how it fits.

marigold.persona: Size 9.5, wide feet, wedding guest, casual-shoe wearer
marigold.text: The gold Marigold looks like exactly what I saw in the ad and should dress up a wedding outfit. I'd have liked some info on fit and comfort for standing three hours, and it only comes in Regular width.

marigold.persona: Size 6.5, wide feet, office, wants leather · bought Clementinne instead
marigold.text: I loved the Marigold in the ad, but the page says metallic faux leather and I wanted real leather, so I went with the Clementinne in leather instead. It has a pointed toe and the page lists the width as regular, so I'm a bit worried about my wide feet.

marigold.persona: Size 6.5, wide feet, nurse, comfort first · bought Lededanten instead
marigold.text: Nothing here is a real nursing shoe, but this flat faux-suede loafer is matte and has a low 2 cm heel and a buckle, so it's the most workable option. I wish the page said something about cushioning and width.

clementinne.persona: Mock customer · US 8, wide feet, 10-hour days
clementinne.text: The cognac loafer looks great in the photo and I got my usual 8. It says Width: Regular, though, and I have wide feet. I'd have liked to know if there's a wide option or how it fits before I ordered.

guavaberry.persona: Mock customer · US 8, wide feet, 10-hour days
guavaberry.text: Loved the glossy pointed look from the ad, so I grabbed my usual 8. But the page says width is Regular and the toe is pointed, and I'm on my feet 10 hours with wide feet, so I'm not sure about comfort.

stormport.persona: Mock customer · US 8, wide feet, 10-hour days
stormport.text: Olive rain boot like the ad, so I got it in my usual 8. The page lists width as "Regular" and says nothing about cushioning or all-day comfort, which matters since I'm on my feet 10 hours.
